entry.description: Cherry blossom tree: Sakura ~5.5 m tall, 7 m wide. Trunk: twisting tapered tube 2.2 m high, Ø0.5 base to Ø0.28 top with flared root. 6 branches evenly spaced around Y, arcing out to ~3-3.3 m and up to ~4 m, each with a fork twig. ~64 blossom clumps (r 0.6-1.3) along outer branches

def.description: Sakura ~5.5 m tall, 7 m wide. Trunk: twisting tapered tube 2.2 m high, Ø0.5 base to Ø0.28 top with flared root. 6 branches evenly spaced around Y, arcing out to ~3-3.3 m and up to ~4 m, each with a fork twig. ~64 blossom clumps (r 0.6-1.3) along outer branches in a ~3.5 m radius disc at y 3.2-5.2, 9 hanging low at the rim on drooping twigs. 180 ground petals (r 0.3-3.5 m). Materials: bark, blossom (vertex colors), petals (vertex colors).
